original: The park is renowned as many famous Dolomite peaks are located within it, among which the north faces of the Tre Cime di Lavaredo stand out.
translated: Der Park ist berühmt, da sich darin viele berühmte Dolomitengipfel befinden, unter denen sich die Nordwände des Tre Cime di Lavaredo abheben.
